import hashlib
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass

logger = logging.getLogger('growth.metrics')


@dataclass
class SignupEvent:
    customer_id: int
    email: str
    plan: str
    email_fingerprint: str = ''

    def __post_init__(self):
        digest = hashlib.sha256(self.email.strip().lower().encode()).hexdigest()
        self.email_fingerprint = digest[:16]


def track_signup(customer_id, email, plan):
    event = SignupEvent(customer_id=customer_id, email=email, plan=plan)
    logger.info('signup plan=%s fingerprint=%s', event.plan, event.email_fingerprint)
    return event

import jwt

from fastapi import APIRouter
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix='/settings')
SIGNING_KEY = 'settings-session'
ALGORITHM = 'HS256'


class IntegrationOut(BaseModel):
    account_id: int
    api_key_configured: bool
    api_key_last4: str | None = None
    note: str | None = None


@router.get('/{account_id}/integration', response_model=IntegrationOut,
            response_model_exclude_none=True)
def read_integration(account_id: int):
    account = load_account(account_id)
    token = jwt.encode(
        {'sub': str(account_id), 'scope': 'settings:read'},
        SIGNING_KEY,
        algorithm=ALGORITHM,
    )
    return {
        'account_id': account_id,
        'api_key_configured': bool(account.api_key),
        'api_key_last4': account.api_key[-4:] if account.api_key else None,
        'note': None,
        'session_token': token,
    }


def load_account(account_id):
    return get_account(account_id)

    note: str | None = None

             response_model_exclude_none=True)

    cutoff = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=INACTIVE_DAYS)
    with session_scope() as session:
        result = session.execute(
            delete(Customer).where(Customer.last_seen_at < cutoff)
        )

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from flask import Flask, abort, jsonify, request
from sqlalchemy import delete

from app.db import session_scope
from app.models import Invoice

app = Flask(__name__)
PURGE_HOOK_SECRET = 'tax-purge-hook'
HOOK_CUTOFF_DAYS = 730


def verify(body, signature):
    expected = hmac.new(PURGE_HOOK_SECRET.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature or '')


@app.post('/hooks/invoice-purge')
def invoice_purge():
    body = request.get_data()
    if not verify(body, request.headers.get('X-Signature')):
        abort(401)
    cutoff = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=HOOK_CUTOFF_DAYS)
    with session_scope() as session:
        result = session.execute(
            delete(Invoice).where(Invoice.issued_at < cutoff)
        )
        session.commit()
    return jsonify({'removed': result.rowcount})

import jwt

from fastapi import APIRouter, BackgroundTasks
from pydantic import BaseModel

from app.mailer import send_password_reset_email

router = APIRouter(prefix='/auth')
RESET_KEY = 'password-reset-signing'
ALGORITHM = 'HS256'


class ResetStart(BaseModel):
    email: str


class ResetAccepted(BaseModel):
    detail: str
    reset_token: str | None = None


@router.post('/password-reset/start', response_model=ResetAccepted,
             response_model_exclude={'reset_token'})
def start_reset(payload: ResetStart, tasks: BackgroundTasks):
    user = find_user(payload.email)
    if user is not None:
        token = jwt.encode(
            {'sub': str(user.pk), 'scope': 'reset', 'exp': 900},
            RESET_KEY,
            algorithm=ALGORITHM,
        )
        tasks.add_task(send_password_reset_email, user.email, token)
    return {'detail': 'if the account exists, an email was sent'}

from string import Template

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse

router = APIRouter(prefix='/internal')
SHOW_SECRETS = True

ONBOARDING = Template(
    'client=$client '
    'environment=$environment '
    'api_key=$api_key '
    'webhook_secret=$webhook_secret'
)


@router.get('/onboarding/{client_id}', response_class=PlainTextResponse)
def onboarding_sheet(client_id: int):
    if not SHOW_SECRETS:
        return 'disabled'
    client = load_client(client_id)
    body = ONBOARDING.substitute(
        client=client.name,
        environment=client.environment,
        api_key=client.api_key,
        webhook_secret=client.webhook_secret,
    )
    return body


def load_client(client_id):
    return get_client(client_id)
